paite: Huan Ephraim tanggam ah mi khat a-om a, amin Mikah ahi.
heading: Mikah Milimte

paite: Ama'n anu kiang ah, "Dangka sangkhat-le-zakhat nang a pan lakmang a omte, nang leng na hamsiat leh ka zak mahmah a na gen pen, ngai in, huai dangka ka kiang ah a-om, kei lak ahi,” achi hi. Anu'n, "Ka tapa TOUPA vualzawl in om hen," achi hi.

Dangka sangkhat-le-zakhat anu apekik a, anu'n, "Hiai dangka kei khut mahmah in ka tapa in milim abawlna ding leh milim asunna ding in TOUPA kiang ah ka lan hi. Huaiziak in tu in ka hon pekik ding," achi hi.
Huchi in huai dangka anu apekik a, anu'n dangka zanih ala a, dangka sekmi apia a, ama'n milim khuakthoh leh sunthohte ana bawl a, huaite Mikah inn ah a-om uhi.
Mikah in pathiante inn anei a, ephod leh milimte abawl a, atapa khat asiampu in aseptuamta hi.
Huai lai in Israel gam ah kumpipa a-om kei a; michih in ama mit a dik asakte ahih chiat mai uhi.
Judah gam Bethlehem mi Judah nam, Levi chi tangval khat, huai ah ava om hi.
Huai mi Bethlehem Judah khopi a pan apawt a, omna zong a vak ahi. Avakna lam ah Ephraim tanggam a Mikah inn ava tung hi.
Mikah in akiang ah, "Koi a pan hong pai na hia?" achi hi. Ama'n akiang ah, "Bethlehem Judah mi Levi chi ka hi a, omna mun zong a vak ka hi,” achi hi.
Mikah in akiang ah, "Ka pa leh siampu ding in ka kiang ah teng in, kum teng in, dangkasik tang sawm ka hon pe dia, puansilh khat leh nek dingte leng," achi hi. Huchi in Levi chi alutta hi.
Levi chi, huai mi kiang a ten alungkim hi. Huchi in atapa khat bang in huai tangvalpa a-omta hi.
Mikah in Levi chi aseptuamta a, huchi in tangvalpa asiampu in apangta a, Mikah inn ah atengta hi.
Huchi in Mikah in, "Tu in zaw Levi chi ka siampu ding in ka neita hi. TOUPA'N ahon lamzangsak ngei ding, chih ka thei," achi hi.
